func (q *LocalQueue) worker() {
	defer q.wg.Done()
	for {
		select {
		case <-q.stop:
			return
		case id := <-q.jobs:
			q.mu.Lock()
			state, exists := q.states[id]
			if !exists || state == jobCancelled {
				delete(q.states, id)
				q.mu.Unlock()
				continue
			}
			ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
			q.states[id] = jobRunning
			q.cancels[id] = cancel
			q.mu.Unlock()

			_ = q.handler(ctx, id)
			cancel()
			q.mu.Lock()
			delete(q.cancels, id)
			delete(q.states, id)
			q.mu.Unlock()
		}
	}
